sentences.en: His bad behavior is a reflection on his common sense.
sentences.zh: 他的不良行为反映了他常识的缺乏。

sentences.en: A little reflection will make you realize you are wrong.
sentences.zh: 稍加思考你就会意识到自己错了。

sentences.en: A little reflection will show you that you are wrong.
sentences.zh: 稍微想想你就会发现你是错的。

senses.zh: 反射，倒影；深思，考虑；映象，映像
